verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Issuing offers a 'Report' webhook type and transfer/payment webhooks that notify when funds are added to or deducted from balance accounts. These are machine-readable signals a finance stack could consume, but nothing describes the report contents, a daily settlement file, or a report API. Card payments are otherwise viewable only in the Customer Area UI. Missing for 10: documented daily settlement or reconciliation file formats, report API or download endpoints, explicit interchange/fee/network-adjustment line items in reports, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
